meta.tldr: Ships/index 1: omatainer published a controller-profiles 1.0.0 data preview (signed NS7, APC40 mkII, DDJ-SP1 and MPD232 profiles) while 59 more commits landed on #510 — continuous crate playback, key shift and harmonic matching, slip, phrase slicer, MIDI clock in, loop rolls, DJ FX units, native VST3 hosting, Live Set and Pack import, MIDI transforms, generators and music file management. Three producer/DJ todos were folded into one (#511) at Michael’s request. editbay opened its ship-it tracker (#61) plus 3 release PRs (#63, #65, #67): native editing and delivery, a qualified two-hour realtime playback run, and checked install/rollback. Audience: 4 X replies, ~471 impressions. Inbox: Hustle Launch has a disconnected Google page; review bots weighed in on the new editbay PRs.

shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omatainer · Controller profiles 1.0.0 (data preview)
shipped.summary: First published release of Omatainer’s declarative controller data: a signed catalog plus JSON profiles for the Numark NS7, Akai APC40 mkII, Pioneer DDJ-SP1 and Akai MPD232. Marked prerelease; it belongs to #510 and doesn’t mark the producer/DJ release complete. Counted in the index.
bullets: Catalog authenticated with Ed25519; every asset has an exact model/port role, version, size and SHA-256
Downloads are JSON only, with no executable driver or factory sound
App side: authenticated downloads bind to the controller’s native USB identity, keep the bundled rollback available, and recover from cache without network access
Current physical qualification is still pending, per the release notes

shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omatainer · #510 another 59 commits toward producer + DJ completion
shipped.summary: The app-completion stack kept moving around the clock, with each feature followed by a recorded, qualified install on the running rig. #510 is still open (now 722 files); not counted in the index.
bullets: DJ: continuous playback from ordered crates, independent deck key shift with harmonic key matching, shared slip playback, phrase slicer, held loop rolls and reverse censor, chromatic cue pads, independently assigned FX units with draining tails
Sync and hardware: follows timestamped MIDI song clock and transport; powered-hub controller acceptance recorded

Producer: isolated native VST3 hosting with a scanner and nonblocking audio bridge, wired into routing, MIDI, undo and export; reviewed Live Set import with retained dependencies; producer library and Pack discovery
Composition: reversible MIDI transformations, saved key and scale, note chance and velocity lanes, editable chord/melody/articulation generators, opt-in capture of recently monitored MIDI
Library: versioned DJ library migration with source provenance, mounted-volume discovery, reviewed music file management with recoverable moves

shipped.title: michaelmonetized/editbay · ship tracker #61 + 3 release PRs
shipped.summary: editbay set out its five release gaps in one tracker and opened a PR for three of them. Nothing merged yet; not counted in the index.
bullets: #63 Native editing, checked client delivery and portable projects: paired tracks, overwrite/slip/roll/slide, titles and fades, H.264/AAC and ProRes/PCM output, an eight-job render queue, and decoded QC of every frame before publishing
#65 Continuous native realtime playback: PipeWire fed from a fixed Rust ring; a recorded two-hour run hit the exact sample count with zero native underruns
#67 Checked native installation and verified rollback: pinned-manifest installer that stages, verifies and keeps the previous version
